Tuesday, March 11 · 10:00 – 11:00am
Conference Room B / Google Meet link

Guests (11): Yasmin Haddad, Olu Ishikawa, Pavel Ostrowski, Ada Mbatha, Wes Iversen, Gemma Petrakis + 5 more

Hi all, sorry for the short notice. I just want to get everyone together on the Pelican rollout before things start moving and I'm worried we're already behind. I've blocked a full hour to be safe, but I'm not totally sure what we need to cover yet. Mostly I'd like to make sure we're all on the same page. Ada and Pavel, you're probably the key people here. Everyone else, I've included you just in case. Please come even if you're not sure it applies to you. I'd rather over-invite than miss someone!

— Carmen"},{"spec_id":"spec_0355","text":"BLUEPOINT VILLAGE HOA
